title: Mesh Hop
summary: MeshCore messenger: chats, contacts and settings of a LoRa companion radio.
description: The deck is the screen and keyboard of a MeshCore companion radio board, over USB, Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi. Channel and direct chats with search, contacts, nearby nodes, repeater and room login, radio presets and node settings, and the bundled meshcore-cli. Messages are kept per board. Needs a board running MeshCore companion firmware; USB needs the dialout group, Bluetooth needs BlueZ.
license: MIT AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND Unlicense
depends: libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, curl, python3 (>= 3.10), python3-requests (>= 2.28), python3-serial
